in_sanskrit.name: नीलान्जना
in_sanskrit.meaning: नील - blue, अजना - without, नजर - grief, anxiety, this name means 'one who is free from the grief of being blue'
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Neelanjana is derived from the Sanskrit words 'nila' which means blue, and 'anjana' which means one who is free from, or without. The prefix 'an' in anjana is used to negate the presence of something. Here, it negates the presence of grief or anxiety, which is symbolized by the color blue. Therefore, Neelanjana can be translated as 'one who is free from the grief of being blue'.

in_hindi.name: नीलान्जना
in_hindi.meaning: नीला - नीला रंग वाला, अजना - अज्ञान से मुक्ता
in_hindi.long_meaning: Neelanjana के नाम में Hindi में 'नीला' शब्द नीला रंग का सिंदूर है और 'अजना' शब्द अज्ञान से मुक्त होना चाहती है। यह नाम ब्लू के रूप वाली शोक से मुक्त होने वाली किसी को बताता है।

in_tamil.name: நீலாஞ்சனா
in_tamil.meaning: நீல - பிரமாத்திய இலை, அஜ்ஜனா - அஜ்ஜாவுக்கான அழித்துக்கோள்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Neelanjana in Tamil language is composed of two words: 'nila' which means blue, and 'ajjana' which means free from the bondage of ignorance. This name symbolizes a person who is free from the bondage of ignorance and is bathed in the blue light of knowledge and wisdom.

in_telugu.name: నీలాజనన
in_telugu.long_meaning: Neelanjana in Telugu language can be translated as 'one who is free from the bondage of ignorance and is in the state of pure consciousness'. The word 'nila' in this name refers to the state of pure consciousness, while 'ajjana' refers to the absence of ignorance.

in_marathi.name: Neelanjana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Neelanjana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Neelanjana is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘neela’ (blue) and ‘anjana’ (lotus). The name evokes the image of a beautiful blue lotus flower, often used as a symbol of purity, detachment, and enlightenment in Hindu mythology.
